mode: standalone stages with versioned Git evidence; no harness-backed assurance claimed

authorization.scientific_direction_and_pivots: User explicitly delegates question, contribution, methods, experiments, journal selection and replacement of research.
authorization.review: User explicitly requests fresh review contexts early and late. Three fresh contexts inspect contribution/fit, methods/statistics and reproducibility/usefulness.
authorization.author_outline_checkpoints: Internal checkpoints under the user's explicit instruction to own and finish the research; do not solicit scientific direction.
authorization.limits: No human studies, new paid services or huge downloads. No submission, payment or publication agreement is authorized by preparing a submission-ready package.
